# Assessing Look-Ahead Bias in Stock Return Predictions Generated By GPT Sentiment Analysis

Source: [primary source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.17322).

## Evidence reviewed

Examines future-knowledge and distraction effects in GPT-based news sentiment. Company-name anonymization improves results in the reported experiment, illustrating that named entities can affect more than economic interpretation.

## Application to Honest Alpha Lab — our recommendation

Add entity-masking sensitivity tests and require extracts with exact source evidence. Treat historical LLM replay as exploratory unless its information boundary is defensible.

## Limits and remaining checks

Anonymization is a diagnostic, not proof that model weights contain no future knowledge. Only the abstract was reviewed; no quantitative replication or universal claim about masking is supported here.
